demo.title: Smart Inventory Management System

demo.mode_desc: Optimized for high-density scanability, predictable keyboard affordances, and zero-distraction warehouse operations.

demo.section_empty_desc: Empty states that educate the operator on what belongs here and how to take the next productive action.
